mainEntity.name: How long does a typical architectural lighting installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an architectural lighting installation varies depending on the project's scope and complexity. A smaller, straightforward residential project might be completed within a few days. Larger, more intricate installations involving extensive trenching, custom fixture placement, or integration with advanced control systems could take several weeks. Factors such as weather conditions, site preparation requirements, and the availability of materials can also influence the timeline. Our team provides a detailed project schedule after the initial site assessment and design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation times vary: smaller projects may take days, while larger, more complex ones can extend to several weeks. Factors like scope, weather, and site readiness influence the schedule.
